environment.description: AWS Lambda function (Python 3.9 runtime) deployed behind API Gateway REST API. The Split.io feature flag 'enable-legacy-pickle-deserialize' is configured with treatment 'on' for all users in the 'production' environment. The Lambda has an execution role with broad permissions (AmazonS3FullAccess, AmazonDynamoDBFullAccess). No input validation layer exists at the API Gateway level. The function is invoked via POST /api/v1/events endpoint.

config.api_gateway: REST API, no request validation model
